options.name: Chrysanthemum's Blooming
options.benefit: Gain Vital Strike and apply it during Spring Attack; at level 16, Improved Vital Strike can be applied instead if possessed.

options.name: Exodus of Jinin
options.benefit: Increase land speed by 10 feet while wearing light or no armor and carrying no more than a light load; select up to three times.

options.name: Harmony of the Tranquil Garden
options.benefit: Focus as a move action for level-scaled blindsense for 1 round.

options.name: Jininsiel's Guidance — Improved
options.benefit: A second selection upgrades Jininsiel's Guidance to improved uncanny dodge.

options.name: Kitsune's Mystique
options.benefit: Gain Improved Feint without prerequisites and feint one threatened creature during Spring Attack or other movement.

options.name: Petals on the Wind
options.benefit: Move 5 feet before making a provoked attack of opportunity, borrowing that movement from the next turn.

options.name: Wrath of the Heavens
options.benefit: Gain Shot on the Run without prerequisites.
